author: DonaldMyTrump
body: Greeting Avicus staff members. My name is YouCantCMe/Zac. I received a kick without a verbal or command warn. As Para stated in my previous appeal verbal and actual warns are interchangeable (note that the list does not include kicks as being interchangeable) . According to the punishment guidelines recently released I should have received a verbal/command warn. For this reason I would like the infraction appealed and removed from my record, since I underwent an excessive punishment already. Thanks.

title: Appeal for TS

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
Hello Zac,

Please Refer to your last appeal which I have already answered. Also depending on the situation, you may or may not receive a warn/verbal warn depending on the severity. You have been spamming the forums with post and seem to disregard what we have responded with and only expect that you be appealed for your actions. Do not create any more appeals regarding already answered situations or you will receive a punishment.

Appeal Denied

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie, Senior Moderator
